## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed its scheduled photographic activity during April 2021. The service recorded 138 captures for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and there were no reported changes to the planned activity. The available capture volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 138 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 0.7 per cent. The result indicates that almost all images were suitable for review. The ungradable image should remain within routine quality monitoring so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed through normal site processes.

## Grading

Grading identified 23 referable results from the monthly activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that results were generally processed promptly during April 2021. The site should continue to monitor turnaround and image quality through its usual operational review, while maintaining the current arrangements for session planning and routine leave.
